readThisFirst: The project is a pseudo-user with the PERSON HELD FIXED: one prompting style, one toolchain, one machine, one era, one account. Between-user variation is not plausibly SMALLER than what is measured here, so every project term below is a lower bound on the between-user term, never a clearance.
privacy: Aggregates and salted workload hashes only. No prompt text, no response text, no file paths.

method.estimator: method of moments, Searle unbalanced two-fold nested design
method.negativeComponents: reported raw as well as clamped; a negative component means indistinguishable from zero at this sample size, not zero
method.iccInterval: project-block bootstrap, 500 draws. WEAK BY CONSTRUCTION: resampling 3 to 8 projects with replacement cannot give a tight interval, and it is published only so the point estimate is not read as precise.

readingGuide.comparison: the band itself spans roughly 4x to 15x from p50 to p99
